onscreen_lines.note: Enter the total purchase price offered for the Property. The Purchase Price shall not be reduced by Buyer’s acquisition, due diligence, financing, title, survey, or closing costs. The only deduction considered in determining the net evaluated bid will be any Buyer’s broker commission requested in the Bid and accepted by the District. Minimum Bid Amount: $8,250,000
onscreen_lines.block: 1 Purchase Price / Bid Amount 1 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.note: Enter the percentage of the Purchase Price requested to be paid by Pearland ISD as Buyer’s broker commission, up to a maximum of 1.00%. If no Buyer’s broker commission is requested, select No Bid. Maximum Commission: 1.00% of the Purchase Price
Enter the total dollar amount of the Buyer’s broker commission requested to be paid from the District’s sale proceeds. If no Buyer’s broker commission is requested, select No Bid.
onscreen_lines.block: 3 Buyer’s Broker Commission Amount 1 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.note: Enter the total purchase price offered for the property, minus Buyer’s Broker Commission. If not applicable, enter full bid amount.
